editorial:
You follow Cole Young, a down-on-his-luck MMA fighter who learns he is part of a bigger fight for Earth. Hunted by Sub-Zero, he joins champions like Sonya, Jax, Liu Kang, Kung Lao, and Raiden to train for a deadly battle against Outworld. The movie feels like a loud, colorful video game brought to life, with big fights, strange powers, and a simple good-versus-evil story. It does not take itself too seriously, so you can just sit back and enjoy the action.

The best parts are the fight scenes, especially the Sub-Zero and Scorpion moments, plus the fun character banter. The story is thin, some effects look rough, and a few characters get little screen time. Still, if you want fast action and familiar game characters, it is a good time.
endingExplained: In the final battle, Cole Young and Earth's champions face Sub-Zero. Scorpion returns from the dead and helps Cole defeat Sub-Zero. Shang Tsung warns that Outworld will return with more fighters. Cole then leaves to find Johnny Cage, setting up another fight. The movie ends with a tease that the tournament is not over and Earth still needs more champions.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves video game action and big fight scenes.
